svg.title: How the harness is built
svg.desc: Architecture. GitHub issues and comments are polled by github.ts. Inside the daemon (harness run) the dsh service layer, ported to TypeScript, filters and takes in each message (service.ts), appends it to the SQLite event log (log.ts), routes it (routing.ts, outbox and attention) to the Opus router session (router.ts), which acts only through five MCP tools (mcp.ts). Tickets start runs in the Atomic 0.9.63 engine (engine.ts, workspace.ts, runs.ts, gates.ts, verify.ts), which loads pstack, the method, into every worker and publishes pull requests as a bot. launchd keeps the daemon alive; a separate watchdog job runs every 120 seconds, restarts a stale daemon, has a model judge stuck runs, and writes only watchdog.judged.
svg.text: THREE PIECES IN ONE DAEMON · DSH SERVICE LAYER, ATOMIC, PSTACK

g.text: pushed by the bot, you merge
starts the daemon, restarts it if it dies
its own launchd job, every 120 s
restarts a stale daemon, a model judges stuck runs, writes only watchdog.judged
